defining_records.title: The Semantic Economy: A Diagnostic Framework for Meaning Under Platform Capitalism
The Capital Operator Stack: Theoretical Landscape and Contribution — A Political-Semantic Analysis of Meaning Governance

captures.description: 'The Capital Operator Stack (COS) is a diagnostic framework originating in critical theory and media studies that outlines how platform capitalism extracts value from human meaning-production.' Maps mechanisms for 'semantic work, strip context, and concentrate power.' Part of Semantic Economy framework. Operations: Semantic Labor, Semantic Capital, Semantic Rent. Zenodo and SciLynk both showing 'The Capital Operator Stack: Theoretical Landscape and...' in organic.

atoms.evidence: The Capital Operator Stack (COS) is a diagnostic
framework originating in critical theory and media studies that outlines how platform capitalism extracts value from human meaning-production.
